title: Kyuutenkai
overview:
A fantastic pinball with realistic movement and a wide variety of gimmicks is here!!

Stop the Demon King's revival!

This fantasy-themed pinball game sets the ball loose on tables crowded with monsters. Living bumpers and roaming enemies populate the playfield, and well-aimed shots knock them down to rack up points and push the quest forward. Pick one of three heroes, each with different attributes, power up the ball to deal heavier damage, and take on bonus rounds away from the main table, including battles against the Demon King's Four Heavenly Kings in the underworld.

リアルな動きに多彩な仕掛け
ファンタジック・ピンボール、登場!!

魔王復活を阻止せよ！
